title: OneAstronomy[1]: Harnessing Multimodal Astronomical Foundation Models to Pave a New Path for Humanity's Sustainable Development
summary: Zhejiang Lab and the National Astronomical Observatories of China report that OneAstronomy, built on Qwen2.5-72B, scored higher than comparison models on two astronomy test sets.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Zhejiang Lab and the National Astronomical Observatories of China built the OneAstronomy research platform on Qwen2.5-72B. They report that it scored higher than the base model, GPT-4o and AstroLLaMA 70B on two astronomy test sets of knowledge and reasoning: GPQA-astro, with 447 questions, and the NAOC-TianYi test set. They give the scores only in charts and name no outside group that ran the tests. Discoveries and public benefits remain unmeasured.
purpose: Support astronomical reasoning, analysis, and access to domain knowledge.
developer: Zhejiang Lab and National Astronomical Observatories of China
